label: 24 GB VRAM
title: Qwen3.8 27B with MTP, 128K context on a 24 GB GPU
summary: The dense 27B model fully on a 24 GB NVIDIA card, with speculative decoding from the model's built-in MTP head. 128K context with a q4_0 KV cache and flash attention.

tested_on.label: NVIDIA GPU with 24 GB VRAM (tested on an RTX 4090), 128 GB system memory

profile.description: Qwen3.8 27B for a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU. All layers and the KV cache on the GPU, with MTP speculative decoding: 4 draft tokens gated by --spec-draft-p-min 0.1 (measured faster than 2 or 8). 128K context, q4_0 KV cache, flash attention, 16 CPU threads for the draft/sampling work. Uses nearly all VRAM, so it runs on its own.

variants.summary: The dense 27B model in ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO IQ3_S quantization, fully on a 16 GB NVIDIA card, with speculative decoding from the MTP head built into the file. 96K context with a q4_0 KV cache and flash attention.

tested_on.label: Sized for a 16 GB NVIDIA GPU (tested on an RTX 4090), 128 GB system memory

profile.description: Qwen3.8 27B for a 16 GB NVIDIA GPU. A 3-bit GSQ-RCO build with its MTP head, every layer and the KV cache on the GPU, drafting up to 8 tokens. 96K context with a q4_0 cache and flash attention. Uses nearly all VRAM, so it runs on its own.
